description: On behalf of UKRI we are looking for an Identity & Collaboration Architect (Inside IR35) for an initial 4 month contract. Remote working with occasional office travel. Establish decision frameworks for identity and namespace management. Lead discovery activities across multiple organisations. Analyse current-state identity, directory and messaging environments. Engage senior stakeholders across IT, security, HR and business functions. Facilitate workshops to define identity, namespace and governance requirements. Essential: Demonstrable experience in designing and delivering Identity Architecture within complex enterprise environments. Strong understanding of directory services, domain architecture and identity lifecycle management. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, conditional access, identity governance and privileged identity management. Proven experience designing and implementing Microsoft 365 architectures. Our mission is specifically to lower the risks to humanity and the biosphere from transformative AI. title: Baufinanzierungsberater:in (m/w/d)
description: Du bist in der Baufinanzierung zu Hause, brennst für den Vertrieb und willst nicht nur Anfragen abarbeiten, sondern mit uns ein eigenes Empfehlungsnetzwerk aufbauen ? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Wir suchen motivierte Berater:innen, die nicht nur beraten, sondern Menschen zu echten Fans von Baufi Deutschland machen – als Kund:innen, als Fans und als Multiplikatoren. Ein typischer Satz von dir könnte sein: „Wenn du jemanden in deinem Freundeskreis hast, der auch bald eine Immobilie kaufen will – nenne ihm gerne meinen Namen :-)“ Du brennst für echte Ergebnisse. Du willst nicht einfach „beraten“, sondern abschließen, weil du überzeugt hast – mit Kompetenz, Herz und einem klaren Mehrwert für den Kunden. Du denkst mit – und willst gestalten Du erkennst Potenziale – bei Kunden, im Prozess, im Vertrieb. Wenn du das Gefühl hast, etwas könnte besser laufen, sprichst du es an und packst mit an. Zum Beispiel: Du siehst eine Lücke in der Kundenkommunikation? Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team E-Mail-Vorlagen oder Formulare, die besser passen. Du merkst, dass viele Kunden dieselbe Frage stellen? Du schlägst vor, dazu ein kurzes Erklärvideo zu drehen – oder schreibst selbst einen Mini-Leitfaden. Eigenverantwortung ist für dich keine Belastung – sondern ein Privileg Du bekommst bei uns nicht täglich neue Aufgaben zugewiesen. Du bekommst Freiraum – und das Vertrauen, ihn sinnvoll zu nutzen . Das bedeutet auch: Du setzt dir selbst Tagesziele Du organisierst deine Woche eigenständig – und entscheidest selbst, wann du deinen Fokus auf Abschluss oder Nachbetreuung legst. Kundenbeziehungen sind dir wichtiger als „schnell fertig“ Du willst langfristig Vertrauen aufbauen – nicht nur ein Produkt verkaufen. Das bedeutet: Du hörst genau hin: „Was ist dem Kunden wirklich wichtig?“ Du gehst auch mal den Extra-Schritt: z. B. erklärst du die Kreditverträge nochmal in Ruhe oder bereitest für den Kunden eine Übersicht auf, die er dem Partner/der Partnerin zeigen kann. Und: Du bleibst auch nach der Auszahlung ansprechbar – weil du weißt, dass aus einem zufriedenen Kunden oft der nächste entsteht. Du bist remote – aber nicht allein Auch wenn du im Homeoffice arbeitest: Wir leben Teamgefühl. Wöchentliche Austausch-Calls mit Kolleg:innen Kurze Feedbackschleifen im Whatsapp-Chat oder 1:1 Call Gemeinsame Planung von Aktionen (z. B. für Empfehlungen, Kundennachfassaktionen etc.) 2x pro Jahr treffen wir uns LIVE und verbringen eine schöne und lustige Zeit miteinander. description: Headquarters: EMEA - Remote, UNITED STATES - Remote Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description: Headquarters: UNITED STATES - Remote, LATAM - Remote Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day. About the role We are seeking a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Growth Marketing team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for setting the strategy and executing on lifecycle campaigns across all Consensys products. You’ll look for opportunities to ensure we are bringing a level of personalization in our communication to our users such that every touch point is driving value for our customers and the business. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of taking projects from start to finish with deep experience leveraging customer data to inform their strategy. You’ve developed multiple lifecycle programs at scale, have conducted hundreds of A/B tests, and have even launched new lifecycle channels from the ground up. What You’ll Do: Oversee the lifecycle strategy across Consensys’ product offering (e.g. in-app notifications, in-app banners, push notifications, full screen modals,, etc) Determine the channel and messaging throughout a user’s lifecycle (new user education, activation, engagement, retention) Comfortable working end-to-end on a lifecycle campaign (through setting the strategy, briefing the creative team, building the targeting, QAing the campaign, and measuring results) Develop an experimentation roadmap across lifecycle channels. description: Headquarters: US - Remote At Elation, our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life. We are a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform on a mission to enable every patient to receive the highest quality of care. Since inception, we’ve been focused on building a delightful, world‑class customer experience that empowers physicians to focus on delivering phenomenal care to patients. Elation Health is looking for a Senior Manager, Training & Enablement to build and lead a dedicated function that strengthens how our employees and customers learn. As Elation grows, we’re investing in a coordinated, scalable approach to training and education. You’ll lead a small, nimble team and own internal learning programs for Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Onboarding, Support, and other teams. You’ll also set the direction for customer education, partnering with customer-facing leaders to develop programs for new and existing customers. This is a hands-on leadership role with the opportunity to shape the function’s strategy, programs, and ways of working. title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst – Product Analytics
description: Headquarters: Remote ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast. Overview You'll join ZoomInfo as a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to help drive product strategy through analytics, measurement, and actionable insights across Product, Product Leadership, and Engineering. You will transform complex product and business questions into trusted analytics that influence product outcomes and business performance, partnering closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Data Engineering, and BI teams. This role is ideal for an analytics professional who combines strong product thinking with a bias toward action and wants to shape how analytics informs product decisions at scale. You will define success metrics and measurement plans for product launches, features, and strategic initiatives. You will build and refine KPIs and measurement frameworks that align teams around product and business performance. You will design, analyze, and communicate results from experiments and feature launches, evaluating customer and business impact. title: Join our Product Talent Community!
description: Headquarters: United States | Remote About Upstart At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. Not seeing an open job that matches your skills and experience? We’d love to invite you to join our Product Talent Community. It’s a simple way to stay connected with us — and for us to stay connected with you. By signing up, You’ll receive quarterly updates on Upstart and job alerts. You may receive outreach when a role opens that matches your skills and interests. There’s no commitment — just an open door to explore future opportunities when the time feels right for you. Product Team Our Product team is on a mission to expand access to credit and reimagine the future of lending. We build innovative, data-driven solutions that break down barriers and create financial opportunities for millions. By leveraging technology, user insights, and seamless design, we’re transforming the lending experience to be more inclusive, efficient, and customer-centric.
